ruleExplanations.sensitive-information-request: They asked for a code, PIN, card detail or password. Do not share it. Call your bank using a number you already trust.
ruleExplanations.official-impersonation: They said they were from the police or another authority. Hang up and contact that office using its publicly listed number.
ruleExplanations.digital-arrest: They said you are under digital arrest. Police do not arrest people over a call. Hang up and tell someone you trust.
ruleExplanations.legal-threat: They threatened arrest, a case or a frozen account. End the call and check with your bank or local police directly.
ruleExplanations.video-call-control: They tried to keep you on the phone or video. You can end the call. Hang up and speak to someone you trust.
ruleExplanations.secrecy-demand: They asked you to keep the call secret. Hang up and tell a family member or someone you trust.
ruleExplanations.time-pressure: They rushed you to act. Pause before doing anything. End the call and verify the request yourself.
ruleExplanations.remote-access-install: They asked you to open a remote-control app or read a screen ID. Do neither. Hang up and close the app if it is open.
ruleExplanations.link-request: They asked you to open a link. Leave it unopened. Use the official app or website you normally use.
ruleExplanations.protected-account-transfer: They asked you to move money to a so-called safe account. Keep your money where it is and call your bank directly.
ruleExplanations.illegal-parcel-claim: They said a parcel linked to you contained illegal items. Hang up and check directly with the courier. Keep your details and money private.
ruleExplanations.service-shutoff: They said your KYC had expired or your phone or electricity would be cut off. Check in your usual app or call the provider yourself.
ruleExplanations.upfront-fee: They asked for a fee or tax before releasing a prize, refund or job offer. Do not pay. Verify the offer with the organisation directly.
